title: security: rbac v2 - enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: customers operating in regulated regions require stricter enforcement of Key Management Service (KMS) region residency and more granular RBAC audit trails. This PR implements enforcement hooks in RBAC v2 that ensure KMS keys used for encrypting customer data are pinned to the requested region, augments audit logging to include KMS-residency decisions, and hardens the audit pipeline to avoid drops during partial failures. Motivation: close gaps surfaced in security reviews and a recent compliance request (SUP-4478). Goals: 1) Enforce KMS region pinning at policy evaluation time and fail-fast on violations; 2) Add detailed audit events for KMS key resolution, region validation and policy decisions; 3) Make audit emission resilient (local buffer + retry) so that transient KMS/emitters do not cause silent loss of audit records; 4) Add unit/integration tests and an ops rollout plan for canary + gradual enforcement. What changed (high level): updated rbac policy engine to validate kms:key:flex-residency rules during evaluation, added kms-residency decision enum into audit schema, introduced an audit-emitter wrapper with buffered retry, added feature flag `rbac_v2.kms_region_enforce` and a rollout script to enable enforcement per org, and updated migration to mark existing keys that lack region metadata. Included test matrix and integration harness updates. Checklist: [x] Add policy evaluation hook for KMS region pinning; [x] Emit KMS decision events to audit stream; [x] Buffer+retry wrapper for audit emitter; [x] End-to-end tests covering policy fail/pass paths; [x] Docs + changelog entry; [x] Migration script with safe default; [x] Rollout plan with canary and rollback. Testing and QA: unit tests for policy evaluation, integration tests with mocked KMS to assert region mismatch behavior, e2e smoke in perf-canary with audit collector, ran staging canary against a subset of orgs. Observability: added metrics rbac.kms_region_mismatch{result=fail|pass}, audit_emitter.buffer_size, audit_emitter.retries. Backwards compatibility: added decision enum but maintains previous audit record shapes with optional fields. Rollout: gated by feature flag; initial canary at 5% orgs for 48 hours, then 25% for 72 hours, then full enable. If enforcement triggers unexpected errors, the flag can be rolled back immediately to audit-only mode.

release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 (feature-flagged). Adds KMS residency decision events to audit logs and hardens the audit emitter with buffered retries. Rollout is gated by feature flag rbac_v2.kms_region_enforce; default is audit-only. Operators should run the provided migration in dry-run to identify keys missing region metadata.
migration_notes: Includes a safe migration that backfills kms key region metadata in read-only dry-run. Migration will only write when --apply flag is passed and will emit an operator alert if >5% of keys lack metadata. Rolling back is a no-op; enforcement is gated by feature flag so immediate rollback can be done by disabling rbac_v2.kms_region_enforce.
ops_rollout_plan: Canary rollout: 5% orgs for 48h (audit-only), then 25% for 72h (audit-only), then enable enforcement on 5% for 48h, 25% for 72h, then full. Rollback criteria: spike in rbac.kms_region_mismatch errors >2x baseline, or >1% of requests face enforcement failures. Immediate rollback: disable feature flag and revert emitter to audit-only mode.
safety_and_testing: Unit tests, integration tests with mocked KMS, and staged canary performed. Added alerts for emitter buffer growth and migration backfill failures. Performance: evaluation hook adds ~0.5-1ms median to policy evaluation in microbenchmarks; observed <1% p99 latency regression in staging canary.
notes: This PR touches core security and audit paths; please coordinate post-merge with oncall and infra to schedule the migration dry-run and canary. A follow-up PR will add RBAC UI annotations explaining enforcement status per org.
